Emily —

Great news, and congrats on the approval. For Redwood procurement to enable PO issuance and payment routing we need the following from BrightEdge: 

- Signed IRS W-9 (for US entities) OR signed W-8BEN-E (for non-US entities) — PDF preferred
- Company formation / operating agreement (PDF) or equivalent proof of legal name and address
- Remittance instructions (ACH template or bank letter) if you want direct deposit
- Billing contact with email and phone

Monica (procurement) will own the vendor record creation and will run an EIN check against our tax-validation service. Rishi from Finance will confirm ACH details once we have the bank letter.

If you can attach the signed W-9 and a short note confirming the full legal entity name that will speed things up. We typically create the vendor record within 48 hours of receiving all docs.

Cc'ing Monica and Rishi to pull the PO once vendor setup is complete.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the signed W-9 and the EIN screenshot. I ran the EIN through our vendor-validation service and flagged a small mismatch on the registered business address. To close out setup we need either:

1) a recent bank letter that shows the legal name and routing info (PDF), OR

If you can provide one of those, we'll finish creating your vendor record and push the PO to Finance. Once Finance receives the PO they will issue the official document and you should get a DocuSign notice for initial terms if any signature is required.
